lines.en: I call Touka to find that she's busy this afternoon as she has important rich-girl business to tend to at the Tsukioka Manor.
lines.zh: 我打给 Touka，发现她下午很忙——她在月冈宅邸有重要的「富家女事务」要处理。

lines.en: And while I'm more than happy (for lack of a better word) to just hang up when I hear that, she invites me over to wander around one of their many gardens with her. So I agree.
lines.zh: 虽然我听了这话巴不得（找不到更好的词）直接挂断，可她邀我去他们家众多花园中的一座逛逛。于是我答应了。

lines.en: She sends a car to pick me up and, after another uncomfortable ride, I pull up at the manor and am escorted in by her attendants.
lines.zh: 她派了辆车来接我。又是一段不自在的车程后，我到了大宅，由她的侍从领进去。

lines.en: The first thing I think when I see her is how infrequently she wears that fancy dress now. And I applaud her for how she's managed to sort of...blend in with all of us commoners in a sense.
lines.zh: 见到她时，我第一个念头是：她现在很少穿那条华丽的裙子了。我很佩服她设法在某种程度上……混进了我们这群平民里。

lines.en: She'll never be one of us, though.
lines.zh: 不过，她永远成不了我们中的一员。

lines.en: She's even more of an outlier than I am- and I would break her immediately if she exposed her weaknesses to me.
lines.zh: 她比我还要「格格不入」——而她一旦对我暴露弱点，我会立刻把她毁掉。

lines.en: It would not be intentional, of course. I'd never jump a fence just to trample a flower garden.
lines.zh: 当然，不是故意的。我绝不会翻过篱笆去践踏一座花园。

lines.en: But if that fence does not exist, there's a high likelihood of me being too absentminded to care at all. And she'd be ruined in the process.
lines.zh: 可要是那道篱笆不存在，我多半会心不在焉到根本不在乎。而她就会在这过程中被毁掉。

lines.en: Spring is the season for flowers. And the pungent scent of sakura from an everblooming tree hunts me from what I can only imagine is a mile away.
lines.zh: 春天是花的季节。一棵常开的樱花树散发出浓烈的气味，从我猜是一英里外的地方「追猎」着我。

lines.en: It makes me want to jump a fence.
lines.zh: 它让我想翻过那道篱笆。

lines.en: It makes me want to blame her.
It makes me want to hurt her.
